name: kxzelenskyputin
title: Will Zelenskyy and Putin speak?
settlement: Resolves Yes if Zelenskyy and Putin meet directly in real time, in person or by phone or video call, before the market date. Written correspondence, intermediaries, mere presence at the same event, cancelled meetings and near-misses do not count.
decideContext: Estimate how this news changes the chance that Zelenskyy and Putin hold a direct, real-time conversation or meeting before the deadline (Jan 1 2027, Jan 1 2028 or Jan 20 2029). The market resolves Yes on the first qualifying direct contact.
